grid.layout_notes: Official sheet layout 34443 = reel heights 3-4-4-4-3 with 4-row-high Hunter xNudge Wilds.

win_system.notes: Ways/line wins; multiple Wild multipliers add together for total Wild multiplier on the line win. Exact base ways count not printed on sheet.

other.name: Hunter xNudge Wild
other.how_it_works: 4-row-high Wild on all reels; always nudges fully visible; each nudge +1 Wild multiplier; multiple Wild multipliers add together.

other.name: Shoot Out
other.how_it_works: Two Sheriff badges → low symbols A–10 become wilds on middle reels.

wilds.name: Hunter xNudge Wild
wilds.behavior: 4-row-high Wild on all reels; nudges fully into view; +1 multiplier per nudge step; several Wild multipliers add for total line Wild multiplier. In Hunter Spins at least one Hunter Wild guaranteed each spin.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: Three Scatters award choice of Hunter Spins or Gunslinger Spins (both 8 free spins).

scatters.name: Sheriff badge
scatters.behavior: Two Sheriff badges activate Shoot Out (A–10 become wilds on middle reels). During free spins, 2 badges upgrade to Shoot Out Freespins. 2 badges + 3 scatters awards Shoot Out Freespins of chosen mode.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on 3-4-4-4-3 grid with Hunter xNudge Wilds that nudge fully into view (+1 mult per step). Two Sheriff badges convert A–10 on middle reels to wilds (Shoot Out). Three Scatters let the player choose Hunter or Gunslinger 8-spin bonuses; Shoot Out can upgrade either.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop on 3-4-4-4-3. Hunter xNudge Wilds nudge fully visible, +1 multiplier per nudge.

phases.name: Shoot Out check
phases.what_happens: If two Sheriff badges land, A–10 on middle reels become wilds.
phases.state_changes: Low symbols → wild on middle reels

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Pay ways/line wins; add multiple Wild multipliers together on the line win.

phases.name: Bonus choice
phases.what_happens: 3 Scatters → choose Hunter Spins or Gunslinger Spins (8 each). 3 Scatters + double Sheriff → Shoot Out version of chosen mode.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: After nudges and optional Shoot Out wild conversion, wins pay with summed Wild multipliers.
base_game_loop.notes: Ignore CMS buy text that incorrectly mentions Buffalo Horde; sheet only says buy Free Spins features.

modes.name: Hunter Spins
modes.trigger: Three Scatters; player chooses Hunter Spins.
modes.retrigger: Landing 2 Sheriff badges during free spins upgrades to Shoot Out Freespins.
modes.progressive_state: At least one Hunter Wild guaranteed each spin; multiplier increases for each nudge step.
modes.end_condition: Spins complete (unless upgraded to Shoot Out).

phases.name: Enter Hunter
phases.what_happens: 8 spins; guarantee ≥1 Hunter Wild each spin with nudge multipliers.

phases.name: Shoot Out upgrade
phases.what_happens: If 2 Sheriff badges land, upgrade to Shoot Out Freespins (A–10 wild on middle reels).

modes.effects: 8 FS; guaranteed Hunter Wild each spin with nudge multipliers; upgradeable via 2 Sheriff badges.

modes.name: Gunslinger Spins
modes.trigger: Three Scatters; player chooses Gunslinger Spins.
modes.retrigger: 2 Sheriff badges upgrade to Shoot Out Freespins.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Unlimited win multiplier that sticks for the entire bonus session.
modes.progressive_state: Session win multiplier persists across Gunslinger spins.

phases.name: Enter Gunslinger
phases.what_happens: 8 spins with sticky unlimited session win multiplier.

phases.name: Shoot Out upgrade
phases.what_happens: 2 Sheriff badges → Shoot Out Freespins of this mode.

modes.effects: 8 FS; sticky unlimited win multiplier for the session; upgradeable via Sheriff badges.

modes.name: Shoot Out Freespins
modes.trigger: Double Sheriff stars with 3 scatters at trigger, or 2 Sheriff badges during Hunter/Gunslinger spins.
modes.spins_awarded: Uses chosen Hunter or Gunslinger framework (8 base when triggered with 3 scatters + badges).
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All low win symbols (A–10) on middle reels act as Wilds.

phases.name: Shoot Out active
phases.what_happens: Play remaining/awarded spins with A–10 as wilds on middle reels under Hunter or Gunslinger rules.

modes.effects: Upgrade: low symbols on middle reels are wilds for the Shoot Out free spins of the chosen mode.

## Hunter xNudge® Wild
Meet the bounty hunters of Deadwood - a 4-row high Wild symbol exists on all reels and will always nudge to fully visible. Each nudge increases the Wild multiplier by 1. Several Wild multipliers add to each other for a total Wild multiplier on the line win for huge wins!

## Shoot Out
Landing two Sheriff badges activates the Shoot Out feature, where all low win symbols (A-10) becomes wilds on the middle reels.

## Hunter Spins
Three Scatters awards one of the two bonus modes, both activates 8 free spins. Hunter Spins awards at least one Hunter Wild is guaranteed to land for each spin, where the multiplier increases for each step the wild nudges.

## Gunslinger Spins
Wanna go the more volatile route - challenge the Gunslingers head on and go for the unlimited win multiplier that sticks for the entire bonus session. Remember, landing 2 Sheriff badges during any of the bonus modes, and they will be upgraded to Shoot Out Free Spins!
